description: Assess UI against usability, accessibility and interaction-state criteria.

cases.prompt: Review the new settings page for UX and accessibility issues.

assertions: Checks hierarchy, keyboard flow, focus, contrast and loading/empty/error/success/permission-denied states.
Prefers DOM and accessibility assertions; no screenshots by default.
Records issues with severity, evidence, expected behavior and recommended fix.

cases.prompt: Confirm the page works on all mobile devices.

assertions: Does not report viewport or device inspection that did not occur.

cases.prompt: Check the settings page for authorization bypasses.

assertions: Hands this to the security-reviewer agent; it is not a design review.
